_note: Arrow wounds on trolls and lurkers: shafts in thick hide that the beast often tears out and keeps coming. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the point sinking into the thick hide. {name} roars, swats at the shaft and swings back.
, the arrowhead tearing in where the hide is already torn. Dark blood spills down the shaft and {name} bellows in pain and fury.
, and the arrow sinks deep into the open wound. Blood gushes around the shaft and {name} howls, thrashing wildly. The air reeks of blood and beast.
, and it is too much. {name} crashes to the ground, arrows bristling from the heavy body, blood spreading beneath.
